item.summary: The Inter-Ministerial Group (IMG), chaired by the Secretary, Department of Public Enterprises (DPE), and co-chaired by the Secretary, Department of Telecommunications (DoT), has recommended asset monetisation proposals involving assets valued at over ₹1,100 crore for consideration and approval by the Alternative Mechanism (AM).
item.title: Inter-Ministerial Group Recommends Asset Monetisation Proposals Worth Over ₹1,100 Crore for Approval by Cabinet-Delegated Alternative Mechanism
